description: This file defines a PHP interface 'LoggerTemplate' intended for logging functionality within the SuiteCRM system. It includes a documentation comment and a single method 'log' that classes implementing this interface should define.

classes.name: LoggerTemplate
classes.description: An interface specifying a logging method to be implemented by classes that perform logging within the application.

methods.name: log
methods.description: A method for logging messages at specified levels; to be implemented by classes adhering to the LoggerTemplate interface.
